result.claim: The five pinned public primary sources do not establish a reproducible production T8103 execution path or custom-loader handoff applicable to iPad13,8 / J522AP build 24B119.
result.limits: This bounded public-source scan cannot exclude private, undisclosed, future, or different-build paths. The same-silicon source uses another board, and the same-build source uses another device. No physical experiment ran.
contradictions: Early M1 ROM is reported affected by usbliter8, but the production M1 ROM revision is explicitly reported unaffected.
Same-build dyld robustness findings exist, but they do not supply the missing kernel or boot-policy authority edge.
failed_avenues: Same-silicon J407 work ends at the same unresolved production T8103 entry boundary.
The early M1 USB route does not apply to the production M1 B1 ROM revision.
Same-build dyld findings do not show a target-applicable native-entry chain.
Apple's 27.2 advisory documents fixed issues but no production T8103 custom-loader path.
result.next_check: Reopen only for a new pinned primary source that shows an ordinary-app-reachable 24B119 kernel or authenticated-control primitive, a production M1 B1 ROM host-input path to controlled execution, or a J522AP custom-loader handoff.
